messages.subject: For Dr. Dominik von Achten | Decarbonisation, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Beumelburg,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Dominik von Achten, Chairman of the Managing Board.

Heidelberg Materials' Strategy 2030 places sustainability, low-carbon products and industrial transformation at the center of long-term value creation. Major CCS and decarbonisation programs also increase the importance of government alignment, stakeholder confidence and disciplined execution around external commitments.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major industrial operation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and I coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Heidelberg Materials' decarbonisation, external-affairs, sustainability or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
